notes: ROS 2 package providing three message definitions (rosidl_generate_interfaces, CMakeLists.txt:27-32) plus a C++ library. Ports exist for the 5 field elements (msg_type = parent message) and 3 msg elements; definition_id is the sha256_normalised proxy of each .msg file (no external dependency definitions needed: Gid and NodeEntitiesInfo are same-package types). QoS, rate, units are null for all ports: these are message definitions, not endpoints, and the package creates no publisher/subscription itself. No port for topic:ros_discovery_info: the name does not occur in the snapshot; rmw_dds_common::Context holds pub/sub pointers (context.hpp:39-41) and a publish_callback (context.hpp:53-56) supplied by the RMW implementation, which publishes ParticipantEntitiesInfo on a topic whose name and QoS are set outside this package. NodeEntitiesInfo also declares node_namespace and node_name as string<=256 (lines 1-2), not in the packet. references is limited to rmw symbols coupled to the packet elements (GID size/copy); the library also uses many other rmw/rcutils APIs not listed. Gid.data length coupling: convert_gid_to_msg/convert_msg_to_gid memcpy RMW_GID_STORAGE_SIZE bytes into/out of Gid.data (char[16]) with no static_assert in the snapshot; the rmw value itself was not checked (header, not an allowed definition file).
